mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 drops below 0.4 over any 12-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5%, accompanied by rising payroll employment (PAYEMS), indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS drops below 0.5 over any 18-month window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110, signaling strengthening supply chains, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening supply chain periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 450 billion, indicating robust consumer spending, drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or RSAFS growth rate drops below 2% over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 1.5%, signaling monetary tightening, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS growth rate drops below 0.5% over any 9-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A stagnant unemployment rate (UNRATE) between 5.0% and 5.5%, coupled with slowing payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth, indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE between 5.0% and 5.5% AND PAYEMS growth < 1%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS drops below 0.4 over any 15-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 16000, signaling weakening demand, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during a monetary easing cycle.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 48% of triggered instances despite negative signal during easing cycles, or GDPC1 growth rate drops below -1% over any 9-month window.
